digests.name: The Week Ahead Outlook
digests.subject: The Week Ahead Outlook - October 5 - October 11, 2026

issues.where: ★ Festival This Week · Telluride Horror Show
issues.problem: The festival runs October 9–12, but the Week Ahead Outlook covers only October 5–11; October 12 falls outside the newsletter's stated window, and more importantly the festival is listed as a 3-day event yet the date range spans 4 days (Oct 9, 10, 11, 12).
issues.suggestion: Verify whether Telluride Horror Show is 3 days or 4 days and correct either the date range or the '3-day passes' copy accordingly. No automatic fix possible without confirming the correct dates.

issues.where: THU, OCT 8 · 4:00 PM · SMART Board of Directors — ℹ Why This Matters
issues.quote: The agenda hasn't been posted yet — details will follow closer to the meeting.
issues.problem: The intro paragraph says 'The agenda hadn't posted at press time,' which matches the listing. However, the SMART Board item carries the same 'Why This Matters' gondola blurb as the Mountain Village Town Council item — this blurb is duplicated verbatim under two different listings.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicate 'Why This Matters' gondola blurb from the SMART Board of Directors listing (or from the Mountain Village listing), as it appears identically under both.

issues.where: Week Ahead Outlook intro, Thursday paragraph
issues.quote: original songs, and a ogre with a lot of heart
issues.problem: 'a ogre' is a grammatical error; 'ogre' begins with a vowel sound and requires 'an'.

fix.find: original songs, and a ogre with a lot of heart
fix.replace: original songs, and an ogre with a lot of heart

issues.where: Week Ahead Outlook intro, Wednesday paragraph
issues.quote: The Mountain Village Town Council Meeting runs all day as the annual budget work session
issues.problem: The listing gives the Mountain Village Town Council Meeting a time of 10:00 AM–5:00 PM, but the intro says it 'runs all day,' and the body says 'The morning covers general fund revenues… After lunch…' — the session starts at 10:00 AM, not at the start of the day, so 'runs all day' is an overstatement and inconsistent with the 10:00 AM start shown in the listing. This is a factual inconsistency a reader would notice.
issues.suggestion: Change 'runs all day' to reflect the 10:00 AM–5:00 PM schedule, e.g., 'runs from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.'

fix.find: The Mountain Village Town Council Meeting runs all day as the annual budget work session
fix.replace: The Mountain Village Town Council Meeting runs 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. as the annual budget work session

issues.where: WED, OCT 7 · 9:00 AM · Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee — tag
issues.quote: Town of Telluride · Telluride Housing Authority Subcommittee
issues.problem: The Telluride Housing Authority is a separate legal entity from the Town of Telluride; tagging it as 'Town of Telluride' misidentifies the governing body. This could mislead readers about which body is acting.
issues.suggestion: Change the tag to 'Telluride Housing Authority' rather than 'Town of Telluride'.

issues.where: WED, OCT 7 · 4:00 PM · Telluride Ecology Commission
issues.quote: the agenda posts closer to the date on the Gov-Hub
issues.problem: The item says 'agenda not posted' in effect ('the agenda posts closer to the date'), yet other items without agendas say 'The agenda hasn't been posted yet.' Inconsistency aside, the main issue is that the listing has no 'View agenda' link, which is consistent with the text — but the text 'the agenda posts closer to the date on the Gov-Hub' reads as leftover placeholder/template text rather than polished newsletter copy.
issues.suggestion: Rewrite to match the standard 'agenda not yet posted' phrasing used elsewhere, e.g., 'The agenda hasn't been posted yet — details will follow closer to the meeting.'

fix.find: Regular public meeting — the agenda posts closer to the date on the Gov-Hub.
fix.replace: Regular public meeting — the agenda hasn't been posted yet; details will follow closer to the meeting.

issues.where: Last Week's Meetings, Recapped · THU, OCT 1 · Town Council Budget Work Session
issues.quote: Town of Telluride · Town Council Budget Work Session
issues.problem: In the recaps section, this item is tagged 'Town of Telluride · Town Council Budget Work Session' — the body of the email consistently uses full names like 'Town of Telluride Town Council' in listings, and the tag here omits the town name from the title but retains it in the tag, which is acceptable per the instructions. However, October 1, 2026 is a Thursday, and the recap date shows 'THU, OCT 1' — October 1, 2026 is actually a Thursday, so that is correct. No error here on the date.
issues.suggestion: No change needed — date and day match.

issues.where: Week Ahead Outlook intro, Tuesday paragraph
issues.quote: the Telluride Town Council meets with two items worth your attention
issues.problem: The listing shows the Town Council meeting at 10:00 AM, but the intro says Tuesday — the intro implies morning, which matches. However, the intro says the ALPR work session and the public hearing are both on Tuesday, but the listing time is 10:00 AM, which is fine. The real error: the intro says 'Tuesday, the Telluride Town Council meets' and correctly describes two items, but also says the Ouray County BOCC Special Work Session 'dedicates the day to the 2027 budget' starting at 9:00 AM — that is accurate. No conflict here. Checking the Shrek description: the intro says 'a ogre' — should be 'an ogre'.

fix.find: and a ogre with a lot of heart
fix.replace: and an ogre with a lot of heart

issues.quote: Community information for Telluride, Mountain Village & San Miguel County.
issues.problem: The footer omits Ouray County (and SMART), but the email explicitly covers Ouray County meetings and a regional body (SMART). A reader would see the Ouray County BOCC recap and notice the footer excludes it from the stated coverage area.
issues.suggestion: Expand the tagline to include Ouray County, e.g. 'Community information for Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County & Ouray County.'

fix.find: Community information for Telluride, Mountain Village & San Miguel County.
fix.replace: Community information for Telluride, Mountain Village, San Miguel County & Ouray County.
